description.en: Korean language pack for DeepSeek Harness: 68 dictionaries / 3,019 strings refreshed for DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2, scoped Pretendard typography, marketplace-ready.
description.ko: 딥시크 하네스 한국어 언어팩: DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 기준 68개 사전 / 3,019개 문자열, Pretendard 타이포그래피, 마켓 등록 지원.

release.notes: v0.2.4 translates the DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2 first-run onboarding (39 settings.account.onboarding* strings), replaces six three-dot ellipses with the ellipsis character, and re-verifies all 68 dictionaries / 3,019 keys against the installed runtime (0 missing, 0 extra, 0 placeholder mismatches). English README.md remains the default document with a reciprocal Korean README.ko.md; CHANGELOG.md and CHANGELOG.ko.md record the version history.
